mentions.name: LowResRMX
mentions.description: A fantasy console for iOS and iPadOS, forked from LowRes NX, that lets the builder create games on the go, such as during commutes. Progress is documented in a YouTube playlist and discussed in a Discord channel.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a fantasy console that work on iOS and iPadOS
https://github.com/moechofe/LowResRMX

My goal is to create games on the go, during my commutes.

It's a fork of https://lowresnx.inutilis.com/, there is some videos of my progress on https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLtmKVaz_2Cxe6pG7VbQfw5drkJsSpV3C6 and a Discord channel https://discord.gg/jcT9CXDgHB
